text:
maya: FYI — live soft-roll of v2 routing hit a quota/cost spike for a few tenants this morning. Need a short rollback & pinning playbook for the console. Anyone able to draft? :eyes:
logan: saw alerts, +1. spike ~09:12 UTC — ~12 tenants hit soft-grace quota -> billed at overage tier. console shows route auto-switched to v2.
tessa: quick Q — is this the `implicit-route` switch we enabled last week?
maya: yes. implicit-route defaults to prefer v2 when latency within 10%, but some clients have large seq-len -> token amplification.
alex: Rec notes — immediate mitigations: 1) pin affected tenant to v1 via console (per-route toggle). 2) enable quota smoothing (`soft_grace_smoothing` = on). 3) roll-forward probe on small % of traffic. I'll paste curl snippets. :+1:
alex: ```bash
curl -X POST https://console.internal/api/tenant/pin
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
  -d '{"tenant":"acme","version":"v1","reason":"cost-spike-2024-09-XX"}'
```
sam: can we auto-detect these candidates? ops-bot should annotate alerts with `route_switch_score` and `seq_len_p95` so we can run an auto-pin playbook.
ops-bot: auto: alert annotated: route_switch_score=0.82, seq_len_p95=2048, estimated_token_delta=+4.2M
tessa: UX ask — console pinning currently requires 3 clicks + confirmation modal. Can we add an "emergency quick-pin" button (no modal) for SREs with perms?
maya: yes but gate it: quick-pin should apply TTL=12h by default + require an audit reason string.
logan: telemetry: please tag metrics with pre/post pin token counts and `pin_reason` so we can measure cost delta.
alex: also: add a rollback checklist to the runbook: exact console steps, curl examples, how to disable implicit-route feature flag, how to drain/re-open canary.
sam: I'll add a small dashboard tile for "pin-driven cost delta" and an alert if delta > $200/hr.
tessa: one more — when we pin, do existing sessions still flow to v2 because of active KV caches? risk of state mismatch.
alex: good point. behavior: new requests favor v1 but existing worker connections may keep serving v2 until session/connection TTLs expire. Add `kv_flush=true` guidance for affected pools, but warn: flushing will increase latency temporarily.
maya: thanks — concrete next steps: sam -> dashboard tile; tessa -> quick-pin UX mock; alex -> runbook & curl snippets; logan -> telemetry tagging; i'll coordinate comms + ops-run.
sam: will draft dashboard by EOD. :clock1:
ops-bot: auto: follow-up reminder scheduled in 2h.
